tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers saved on the account (loyalty and contact records). UPOS API: GET /customers.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer record by customer id. UPOS API: GET /customer/{customer-id}.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_customer_loyalties
tools.description: Get the loyalty balances and programs of one customer. UPOS API: GET /customer/{customer-id}/getCustomerLoyalties.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record on the account. Only the fields you pass are sent. UPOS API: POST /customer.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: update one customer record. Only the fields you pass are sent. UPOS API: PUT /customer/{customer-id}.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_store_users
tools.description: List the users (staff) of one store. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/users.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_get_user
tools.description: Get one user (staff member) by user id. UPOS API: GET /user/{user-id}.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_taxes
tools.description: List the taxes of one store. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/taxes.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_list_menu_items
tools.description: List the menu items of one store (items sold on the POS). UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/menuItems.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_sale_report
tools.description: Read the department and category sale report of one store for a date range. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/saleReport.

tools.name: uposcloudpos_transaction_report
tools.description: Read the transactions report (payments and tenders) of one store for a date range. UPOS API: GET /store/{store-id}/transactionReport.
